entities.summary: Sergei Nikolaevich Sorokin is a retired ice hockey player who played in the Soviet Hockey League. He played for Torpedo Gorky and HC Dynamo Moscow. He was inducted into the Russian and Soviet Hockey Hall of Fame in 1993.
